## 3. `SPEC.md` (project root)

**Path:** `C:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\SPEC.md`  
**Length:** 715 lines (full document was read).

It defines: HiFi player goals, MVVM + Clean layout, bottom nav (SPEC: Home | Library | Now Playing FAB | Files | Settings), detailed screen specs, ExoPlayer/AudioFX, 50-level volume math, Room schema, permissions, dependencies, and **Session 1–15 roadmap** (Session 1 scaffold marked complete).

**Implementation note:** Current `AppNavigation` uses **three** bottom tabs (Home, Library, Settings) plus `MiniPlayer` when a track is loaded; there is **no** bottom “Files” tab and **no** central Now Playing FAB in the bar (Now Playing is reached via MiniPlayer or after play). `SPEC.md` describes the target, not necessarily the current UI.

---

## 4. Navigation (no XML graph)

All routes and `NavHost` are in:

`C:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\navigation\AppNavigation.kt`

- **`Screen` sealed routes:** `home`, `library`, `now_playing`, `equalizer`, `file_explorer/{path}`, `album/{albumId}`, `artist/{artistId}`, `playlist/{playlistId}`, `settings`
- **`NavHost` start:** `Screen.Home.route`
- **Bottom nav:** Home, Library, Settings only; **Now Playing hides** the bottom bar (`routesWithoutBottomNav`)
- **MiniPlayer** above the bar when `playerState.currentTrack != null`

**Caveat:** `FileExplorer` route expects a `path` argument; anything that navigates there must pass a valid encoded path (no default “root” route is registered without `{path}`).

---

## 5. ViewModels (9 files) — paths and role

| File |
|------|
| `...\ui\screens\home\HomeViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\library\LibraryViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\nowplaying\NowPlayingViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\equalizer\EqualizerViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\artistdetail\ArtistDetailViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\albumdetail\AlbumDetailViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\playlist\PlaylistViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\settings\SettingsViewModel.kt` |
| `...\ui\screens\fileexplorer\FileExplorerViewModel.kt` |

**Behavior in short:**

- **Home:** Combines recently played tracks, “recent” albums (top 12 by highest `id`), WorkManager scan state, first-launch scan via DataStore `has_scanned`, `rescan`, `playTrack` / favorite via `PlayerController` / repo.
- **Library:** Tab + search; search only affects **tracks** (`flatMapLatest` to `searchTracks` or `getAllTracks`); albums/artists/playlists are not filtered by query.
- **Now Playing:** Merges `PlayerController.state` with `getTrackByIdFlow` for favorite; volume/seek/transport/shuffle/repeat.
- **Equalizer:** Loads presets from Room; waits `effectsReady`, then reads hardware EQ; band/preset/BassBoost/Virtualizer/Loudness.
- **Artist/Album detail:** Load ID → artist/album + flows for albums/tracks.
- **Playlist:** Resolves tracks from JSON `trackIds`; `removeTrack` updates playlist (note: `getTrackById` in `flatMapLatest` is a **suspend chain** wrapped in flow—worth verifying at runtime).
- **Settings:** DataStore keys for theme, gapless, crossfade, default volume, sample rate, hidden files (`libraryPaths` in state unused).
- **File explorer:** Path navigation, breadcrumbs, selection, copy/cut/paste, rename, delete, new folder.

---

## 7. Room — database, entities, DAOs

- **Database:** `...\data\local\db\AppDatabase.kt` — version **1**, entities: `Track`, `Album`, `Artist`, `Playlist`, `EqPreset`; `exportSchema = true`; `BUILT_IN_PRESETS` for EQ seeded in `RoomDatabase.Callback` (note: **`Classical`** band JSON in DB constant differs from the table in **`SPEC.md`** for Classical row).
- **Entities:** `...\domain\model\*.kt` — `@Entity` on Track, Album, Artist, Playlist, EqPreset (`Track`/`Album`/`Artist` use Media Store IDs as PKs).

**DAO files:**

`...\data\local\db\dao\TrackDao.kt`  
`...\data\local\db\dao\AlbumDao.kt`  
`...\data\local\db\dao\ArtistDao.kt`  
`...\data\local\db\dao\PlaylistDao.kt`  
`...\data\local\db\dao\EqPresetDao.kt`

| `...\service\PlayerController.kt` | Singleton `MediaController`, `PlayerState`, queue, polling position, attaches `Equalizer` / `BassBoost` / `Virtualizer` / `LoudnessEnhancer`; playback + effect APIs |
| `...\service\BootReceiver.kt` | `BOOT_COMPLETED` — **TODO** only, no restore yet |

## 10. Hilt / DI

| File |
|------|
| `...\di\AppModule.kt` |

Provides: `AppDatabase` + callback for built-in EQ presets, all DAOs, `DataStore<Preferences>`, `WorkManager`.

`MusicPlayerApp` implements `Configuration.Provider` for `HiltWorkerFactory`; `MainActivity` is `@AndroidEntryPoint`.

## 11. On “full contents” of every key file

Posting **every line** of all of the above (~50+ source files plus 715-line `SPEC.md`) in one reply would exceed practical message size. **Everything requested was read completely** from disk during exploration; authoritative copies are on disk at:

- **Spec:** `C:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\SPEC.md`
- **Kotlin sources:** under `...\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\`

If you want the report to include **verbatim full text** file-by-file, say which subset (for example “all ViewModels + all DAOs only”) and we can output those in follow-up chunks, or rely on opening the paths above in the IDE.

---

### Current-state summary

- **Stack:** Compose, Navigation-Compose, Hilt, Room, Media3 (`ExoPlayer` + `MediaSession` + `MediaController`), WorkManager (`LibraryScanWorker`), DataStore, Coil, Accompanist permissions.
- **Playback:** Centralized in `PlayerController`; UI binds through it; **no** separate XML media service graph.
- **Gap vs SPEC:** Bottom navigation and File entry differ; many advanced features (queue persistence, unified search, sleep timer, album/playlist play wiring, boot restore) are partial or TODO as marked in sources.
